title: Truman interview: UFOs discussed at every military conference
summary: Harry Truman tells of Truman interview: UFOs discussed at every military conference, about 1950s at United States (no place named), and reads it from an official document. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: oh yes we discussed it at every conference that we had with the military and they never had been never were able to make me a concrete report on

plain: Harry Truman, the US president, is heard in an interview played on Jesse Michels's podcast saying that UFOs came up at every conference he had with the military. He says the military, including the Joint Chiefs of Staff, the nation's top commanders, never managed to give him a concrete report on them. If true, it means the subject was on the president's desk in the late 1940s and 1950s, unanswered.
